# AMT Solutions (Pvt) Ltd

AMT Solutions (Pvt) Ltd is a security and smart technology systems provider based in Kandy, Sri Lanka. Founded in 2014, the company specializes in professional CCTV installation, access control, fire alarm systems, structured network cabling, home automation, and PABX communication systems for residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional clients across Kandy, Central Province, and Sri Lanka.

## Core Specialisation
- **CCTV Camera Installation & Surveillance Solutions (Primary focus: CCTV Kandy & Central Province)**: Site assessment, system design, IP camera networks, HD analog systems, NVR/DVR recording, remote smartphone viewing, night-vision infrared cameras, monkey/pest-resistant protective enclosures, and legacy system upgrades.
- **Shop Security & Technology Hardware Supply**: Official supplier and installer of Hikvision IP bullet cameras, vandal domes, eyeball turrets, smart TandemVu dual-lens PTZ cameras, 4G solar-powered security cameras, and AcuSense 4K NVR recorders (4, 8, 16, and 32 channels).
- **Access Control Systems**: Card access readers, biometric fingerprint/facial recognition, electric strike/magnetic door locks, time attendance, and multi-door management.
- **Fire Alarm Systems**: Smoke detectors, heat sensors, fire alarm control panels, sounders, manual call points, and compliance testing.
- **Networking & Structured Cabling**: Cat6/Cat6A data cabling, server racks/cabinets, PoE gigabit switches, and commercial Wi-Fi access points.
- **Home Automation**: Smart lighting, appliance automation, security integration, and mobile app control.
- **PABX & Business Communication**: Intercom systems, IP-PBX, hybrid telephone exchanges, and extension configuration.
